title: Advisor configuration
prompt: Configure a supported executor–advisor pairing and request advice during planning and final review.

examples.code:
model: claude-sonnet-5
multiagent:
  type: multiagent_20261001
  subagents: { type: disabled }
  workflows: { type: disabled }
  advisor:
    type: enabled
    model: claude-opus-5-5
system: >-
  Consult the advisor when planning the approach.
  Implement the work yourself, then consult the
  advisor for a final review before answering.
examples.label: YAML reference excerpt

takeaway: Configure a supported executor–advisor pairing and request advice during planning and final review.
